Name: Cheaper Crafting Recipes
Author: zekrom91
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod changes 10 crafting recipes, making the item cheaper to craft! You are mostly saving a little wood and stone with this. Nothing major.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Unpack the .zip-file and put the folder "[CP] CheaperCraftingRecipes[/color]" in your Mods folder.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

MODDED RECIPE
Chest 20 Wood
Big Chest 60 Wood
Bee House 20 Wood, 1 Iron Bar, 1 Maple Syrup
Keg 20 Wood, 1 Copper Bar, 1 Oak Resin
Dehydrator 20 Wood, 2 Clay, 1 Fire Quartz
Furnace 20 Stone, 10 Copper Ore
Cheese Press 30 Wood, 20 Stone, 5 Hardwood, 1 Copper Bar
Preserves Jar 30 Wood, 20 Stone, 4 Coal
Scarecrow 20 Wood, 1 Coal, 10 Fiber
Tapper 20 Wood, 1 Copper Bar

VANILLA RECIPE
Chest 50 Wood
Big Chest 120 Wood, 2 Copper Bar
Bee House 40 Wood, 8 Coal, 1 Iron Bar, 1 Maple Syrup
Keg 30 Wood, 1 Copper Bar, 1 Iron Bar, 1 Oak Resin
Dehydrator 30 Wood, 2 Clay, 1 Fire Quartz
Furnace 25 Stone, 20 Copper Ore
Cheese Press 45 Wood, 45 Stone, 10 Hardwood, 1 Copper Bar
Preserves Jar 50 Wood, 40 Stone, 8 Coal
Scarecrow 50 Wood, 1 Coal, 20 Fiber
Tapper 40 Wood, 2 Copper Bar

[size=4][b]Requirement &  Shout out[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod has been made possible thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/color]! You need Content Patcher for this mod to work.
